name: Damned

prerequisites.description: You must have had friendly contact with an evil-aligned outsider that would qualify as a challenging foe
have a fiend-related sorcerous bloodline such as abyssal or infernal
have direct fiendish ancestry (such as being a tiefling or half-fiend)
or have the Fiend Raised or The Fiend background (see Ultimate Campaign )

benefit: Bonus to checks relating to evil-aligned outsiders
